/evoka: An interactive installation at BCU Fribourg that connects visitors’ memories with the library’s archives through AI-guided conversation. Led frontend development in Unity.
/ant: Real-time feedback visuals and a Python library developed for EPFL+ECAL Lab research on neurofeedback training for people with tinnitus.
/switch-miso: Andrea Rovescalli helped develop SWITCH Miso at EPFL+ECAL Lab, an AI conversation that helps people explore healthier, more sustainable ways to eat.
/kf: A touch-controlled watch configurator built in Unity HDRP, with real-time 3D rendering of watch components, materials and finishes.
/ecole42: Interactive installations and a mobile AR treasure hunt developed for 42 Lausanne to introduce the school’s peer-to-peer learning culture.
/aef: Interactive 4K installations for Ars Electronica Festival 2016, presenting Earth visualisation, ESA satellite models and geospatial data.
/ansharonline: A multiplayer VR space shooter from OZWE Games. Andrea’s work spans graphics programming, shaders, cinematics and level design.
/baudata: A creative technology collective using bots, weather data and generative graphics to turn skies and landscapes into visual stories.
/bmeia: An interactive media wall that uses maps and data visualisation to explore Austria’s international activities across countries.
/deathlap: A VR combat racing game by OZWE Games and Oculus Studios, featuring Unity shaders, real-time effects and performance work by Andrea Rovescalli.
/doka: Two interactive reference walls for Doka at BAUMA, using a touch-controlled globe to explore construction projects around the world.
/eames: A multimedia exhibition at Salone del Mobile in Milan that revisits Charles and Ray Eames’ work through archival images and an interactive wall.
/fireplace: An experimental light object and mobile app exploring how physical activity, colour and flicker shape the experience of domestic light.
/lightscape: An interactive light installation that translates GPS location, weather data and landscape images into a changing physical composition.
/machine: A playful library concept that helps children discover books and games using a touchscreen table and branching LED paths.
/metec: Interactive 4K walls developed for Primetals Technologies at METEC to make factory data explorable in an immersive exhibition.
/mons: A participatory media project for Mons 2015 that connects georeferenced videos recorded on phones with an interactive public table.
/onceUponATale: A tactile book, card game and interactive storytelling app that let children remix familiar characters and settings into new tales.
/saltmine: A multimedia installation in the Berchtesgaden Salt Mine, combining four projections, crystalline animations and sound inside the Treasure Chamber.
/skater: An iPhone augmented reality skate adventure set in 1980s Berlin, with printed cards and origami pieces that shape the levels.
/spinny: A 2D action-puzzle game for Nintendo Switch and PC about guiding a small alien through mazes in a spinning spaceship.
/spymuseum: Interactive experiences developed with Ars Electronica Solutions for Berlin’s Spy Museum, where visitors explore the history of espionage.
/tabakFabrik: A 12-minute Three.js visual narrative that turns memories of Linz’s Tabak Fabrik into photogrammetric models and data-driven animation.
/vaudoise: An interactive escape game about retirement for Vaudoise Assurances, featuring Unity mini-games, a custom UI and localisation tools.
